private_welcome_text: I run the game in a group chat. How to start: 1) Add me to a group 2) In the group tap /newgame or «Create game» 3) Players tap «Join» 4) When 3–6 players, host taps «Start» 📌 No spam — I edit one panel.
group_welcome_text: This is a detective game. To begin: Tap «Create game» or type /newgame 📜 Rules and commands — below.
rules_text: Currently M1 (lobby) is implemented. Next is M2: cards and turns. ✅ To start — press /newgame
commands_text:
/start — menu
/newgame — create game (group)
/players — refresh panel
/startgame — start (host)
/rules — rules
/help — help
panel_hint_started: Game started (M1). Next is M2: dealing cards and turns.
